title: TheLilypadSMP_basic
description: A set of recommended basic mods for The Lilypad SMP
body:
This is a basic set of mods for The Lilypad SMP. It includes some graphics mods as well as some basic performance optimization mods. 

For graphics the Iris, Continuity and DistantHorizons mods are included. To make use of Continuity you have to enable the two resource packs that are embedded in Continuity: "Default Connected Textures" and "Glass Pane Culling Fix".
